provenance: Official source: yes. This data is BetaNYC's, derived from it, not an official New York City Council record.

BetaNYC downloaded the Council's own workbooks from the Research & Data site (last on 2026-10-12) and committed them with their sha256 (source/expense-funding-disclosure/). This server answers from the SQLite index in its npm package, with no network call. The index is built from the copy committed to this repo. How current: the day BetaNYC downloaded the copy, read from the index.

Changed by BetaNYC: Amounts, names and statuses are as published; exact copies of a row are kept and flagged. Embedded total and footer rows are stripped, never counted. The purpose text is not served. Added by BetaNYC: a 5-digit zip from the published postal code (a ragged or 6-digit ZIP repaired only into a 2020 Census ZCTA of the row's own state, or settled by the street address where it matches exactly one address in the City's PAD file), the Council Member's Legistar person ID from BetaNYC's member crosswalk, and, FY2009–FY2021, the MOCS ID NYC Open Data 4d7f-74pe gives the same designation where the pairing is unambiguous.

BetaNYC pulled the June release of each fiscal year through NYC Open Data's API on 2026-11-09, summed by agency and unit, and committed it (source/agency-budget-qa/). Changed by BetaNYC: Only each fiscal year's June release is used. Adopted FY Y is financial_plan_amount in the June release tagged Y; modified FY Y is current_modified_budget_amount in the June release tagged Y+1 (adopted_budget_amount is never read: it is the year before). Amounts are summed by agency and unit; compare_adopted_modified computes the change. A unit not in a year's budget has no figure, never $0.

provenance: Not an official record: curated by BetaNYC from material published by New York City Council.

BetaNYC extracted the roster and each person's recorded votes from the Legistar index that @betanyc/nyc-council-mcp builds, committed that extract (data/reference/), and resolved each printed name by fixed rules (code/build_member_crosswalk.py): the only person with that name who voted in that fiscal year. The crosswalk is in the server's index; how current is the day that Legistar index was built.

Changed by BetaNYC: A name is resolved only when exactly one Legistar person has it; a name two people share in a year is left ambiguous with its candidates, never guessed. A few printed conventions were decided by a person and recorded with their evidence. Delegations, 'Speaker', district labels and blanks get no person ID.
